items.title: Milford Dolliole Interview, 1965-05-22
items.q: I used to like to hear this fellow, Bebe, used to play drums for the, I forgot what band it was, Manny Perez band.

ctx.x: Yes. Can you tell me when you first heard music, when you got interested in music and what?

Oh, I used to follow the bands when they played the fumes and different things and I got interested in the drums. And I used to like to hear this fellow, Bebe, used to play drums for the, I forgot what band it was, Manny Perez band.

items.title: Milford Dolliole Interview, 1965-05-22
items.q: Yeah, I remember Bill when he played drums. He was a good drummer too.

ctx.x: Yeah, but most likely, under these fellas used to play, the parades could look like their band had the job, contract with the societies. That was the time, yeah. And most likely all the time it would be Charney would be with the Tuxedo band, and Alfred Williams, and Contra was with parades for last month. And the Bay was with the Hornwood band. Oh yeah. And all that sort of thing. I could remember that.
Do you remember the other Matthews brothers that played?

Yeah, I remember Bill when he played drums. He was a good drummer too. I heard he won the parade too. In late years he played one parade once. Yeah, he was a good drummer. Yeah. He was a good drummer. He was a good drummer.
